measurementMethod: Boot: wall time from launch to Done, plus ModernFix total load and datapack load lines. Idle: spark tps/health after 90 s on a fresh world with no players. Worldgen: forceload of a 16x16-chunk square in 16 batches of 4x4, timed to each confirmation; cpuSeconds is the JVM process CPU time over the probe. Runs in ABBA order on fresh worlds; another worker's QA server ran during part of the series, recorded in otherJava* and in machineLoadSamples.
notes: The workstation lost power at about 18:53 local time during the boot of base3 (bootstrap stage, before any world existed); that run was discarded, its process receipt was closed by the owner, both servers were re-verified (every JAR hash) and base3, after3 and after3-noDnT were run again. The system clock restarted behind: load samples jump from 18:52 back to 17:19; each run times itself with its own wall and JVM CPU clocks.

qa0 is the first targeted QA run with the defaults of Slice & Dice and Central Kitchen, before the pack configs that split the kitchen routes; it found the 93 basin-cooking copies that the configs remove.
